sections.title: How the population has changed in Enfield
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Enfield was the 10th largest local authority in London, with a population of almost 330,000. Its population decreased by 0.2% compared with 2023, and has increased by 18.1% since 2001.

sections.title: Population density in Enfield
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Enfield was 4,052 people per square kilometre, which was less than London (5,782), and more than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Median age in Enfield
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Enfield was 38 years, which was older than London (35 years), and younger than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
